name: zc_pso_state

tests.name: the PSO precache settings reached the engine

detail.note: written into [/Script/Engine.RendererSettings], which maps to URendererSettings properties rather than to console variables. If these read zero the ini keys were ignored and the avatar measurement tested nothing -- the fix has to move to [SystemSettings] before the hypothesis can be judged at all.
